subject: Re: Visilant & Encord | Next steps
text:
Hi Kamil,

Thank you for showing us the Encord platform.  As an early-stage nonprofit
with limited resources, we are developing a high-impact product in
healthcare AI. We are exploring options to reduce the overall cost.
Unfortunately the current quote exceeds our budget, as we need to keep
costs to around $20,000 for this to be feasible for our team. Could you
please advise if there are any nonprofit discounts available?

Additionally, we would like to inquire about flexibility regarding the 5
seats. We may not need all 5 upfront and are wondering if we can lower the
base price by incorporating those seats into a $1,000/seat plan.

Finally, for the unlimited labels, is there a potential label cap that
would align with our estimated volume (20k-50k per year) that could reduce
the pricing? We anticipate needing labeling for model training rather than
ongoing, indefinite use.

Thank you,

Nakul

subject: Re: [Thank You] Encord AI Leaders Dinner
text:
Hi Skander,
Sorry for the delay here… I’ve tried to help out but am coming up empty. I’ve talked to a few folks here and they just don’t see the need and thus feel it’s a waste of your time and theirs. Thomas Koletschka is the person I work closest with on AI stuff. Here is a summary of his perspectives;

  *   He understands what you do
  *   “At this point  the volume of our needs is too low to warrant any kind of investment”
  *   On occasion, we do use on-demand services and have had a good experience so see no driver to change
I’m not sure what else I can do… it’s the old bring the horse to water but I can’t make them drink kind of thing.

Sorry I didn’t have a better result but we just aren’t there yet.

All the best,
Craig

subject: RE: [EXTERNAL] Re: Encord/Ideko – Ultrasonic Defect Detection
text:
Hi Alex,

Thank you very much for your recent emails.
Let me briefly introduce myself: my name is Jose, and I am responsible for the NDT  area within the Manufacturing Process Research Line at IDEKO. I work closely with Julen in the different projects that we have in NDT.
I’ve had several meetings with Julen regarding the capabilities of your software and its potential applications in our research activities. We truly see it as a very promising tool that could enhance our scientific and technological developments. However, at this stage, we currently do not have a project or customer that would internally justify an investment in your solution. This does not diminish our interest in your technology. The reality is that we believe that a project-driven opportunity is essential to support the case for such an investment internally.
With that in mind, I’ve suggested to Julen that we explore whether other research areas beyond NDT might have needs that align with your application’s capabilities in IDEKO. We kindly ask for some time to gather feedback from those departments. Therefore, for the moment, we believe a catch-up meeting is not necessary.
In parallel, we have two questions we’d like to raise:

  1.
Technical Question: What is the approach you use for automatic data labeling? Does it require any human supervision? Additionally, why isn’t the same approach applicable during the AI-based detection process?
  2.
Collaboration Opportunity: We are very active in European projects funded by the European Commission (Horizon Europe). Would you be interested in participating as a partner in a future consortium? We don’t currently have an open opportunity, but there may be some in the near future.

Thank you once again, and best regards,
JOSE

subject: Re: Encord/Matta AI - Anomaly Detection
text:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for chatting today! We are keen to move quickly.
Can you give me a little more detail on a few aspects:

   1. How does your software deal with multiple views of the same part /
   process? Can it handle stereo / multi-view data in general?
   2. In a given image group, are you able to support multiple different
   resolutions
   3. Supposing that you support multi-view data, is it flexible enough to
   treat these views differently? E.g. if I have three cameras, two from
   different angles and an additional infra-red camera from a third view, can
   I present these simultaneously to an annotator / model in your annotation
   UI and providing the sources as metadata to differentiate how you act on
   them
   4. Do you support modalities like UV, IR, thermal, X-ray, 3D and 3D
   video, CT, pyrometer scans, audio
   5. Do we keep the data we produce on your platform if we cancel?
   6. Where would the data we produce on your platform be stored? Do we
   need to write it back to our own s3 or is it hosted somehow
   7. Do you have a labelling API that would allow our users to annotate
   without leaving our platform? It would be a pain-point to force customer
   annotators to leave one platform and find another
   8. Can we pay monthly rather than yearly?
   9. Is there a trial/cancellation period where I can allow others to use
   it briefly to assess the product.

Thanks,
Ollie
